name: Brazilian truck leasing sheet (Portuguese XLSX)
note: Placeholder for a non-English lender sheet (e.g. a lease model stating a USD amount of 1,500,000.00, a 60-month term, a local tax context that names the country, and a native-language asset word such as 'caminhão' → commercial_trucks). XLSX file-type support ships (spreadsheet-text.ts → /api/parse/file). Paste the extracted text into doc_text, set expected_fields to the sheet's true values, and flip pending:false. A stated USD figure needs no FX guess. Large sheets on a slow local model can exceed a tunnel's ~100s edge cap and fall back to regex; keep the parse path under ~90s before relying on this case.
